summary_1line: Arjuna urges honoring Dhritarashtra; Yudhishthira offers all wealth for funeral rites of the fallen, and Dhritarashtra conducts lavish gifts and ceremonies for the dead.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima glares angrily at Arjuna while Yudhishthira calmly instructs Vidura to offer all their wealth to Dhritarashtra.
Vidura stands before the blind king Dhritarashtra in the palace hall, delivering Yudhishthira’s message of submission and generosity.
Dhritarashtra presides over a vast ceremony where Brahmanas receive elephants, gold, cattle, and garments in the names of the fallen warriors.
